text: This report is responding to the information in the report entitled "Raising the Alarm: Fraud Investigation of a Vendor Providing Life Safety Inspection Services to the City of Toronto" by the City of Toronto Auditor General dated June 28, 2018 which was considered by the City Audit Committee at its meeting on July 13, 2018. While the report was mainly about the City investigation of life safety vendor services delivered through contracts with the City, as part of this investigation, the Auditor General requested that Toronto Fire Services (TFS) do an investigation of 12 City facilities, including Exhibition Place. The results of those investigations were also presented in the report. Because of the importance of life safety to the Board and our customers / attendees, we immediately sought clarifications from the Auditor General and also provided information to Ms. Josie Scioli, Deputy…
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place received the report (July 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
